author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.44 shipped: Night lights come on in Sleep under sleep protection
summary: Night lights come on in Sleep under sleep protection
why: Master Bath Toilet got no night light at 04:49 because the sleep-protection motion gate (bypass=3) short-circuited all automation, and the reconciler is state-change driven so it never fired. Operator ruled (a): sleep protection only suppresses main lights. Review A found the gated exit path also skipped the night-light off rule (would recreate stuck-on); fixed in-cycle with test + drill.
implications: Shipped NIGHT-LIGHT-ACTION-SELECTOR-1 at v5.103.44; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.44.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: ura_activity_log: Master Bath Toilet first sleep-window entry shows night-light turn_on (sleep) without main-light turn_on, and a night-light turn_off on vacancy

refs.release_notes: During Sleep, an occupied room's night lights come on even while sleep protection is ignoring motion; main lights, fans and covers still wait. Leaving turns those night lights off.
